headline: Agents Learn to Operate the Desktop
lede: Agent Desktop gives computer-use agents a structured map of native accessibility trees instead of brittle pixel coordinates. Its observe–act–observe loop, stable references, and cross-platform Rust core turn desktop control into a traceable procedure.

headline: Claude-Mem Gives Agents a Longer Memory
lede: Claude-Mem captures sessions, distills their useful observations, and retrieves project history when an agent needs it. SQLite storage, Chroma search, and progressive disclosure connect scattered coding sessions without flooding the context window.

headline: Scrapling Unifies the Modern Web Crawl
lede: Scrapling combines HTTP fetching, browser automation, parsing, concurrency, and export in one production-minded Python framework. Sessions, adaptive selectors, crawl state, and anti-bot handling give teams a resilient path from difficult pages to usable data.

headline: Hyprland Makes Wayland Feel Alive
lede: Hyprland turns the Wayland compositor into a visual instrument: tiled layouts, animated transitions, blur, glow, and live configuration all remain under the user’s control. Its socket IPC and plugin system make the polished surface programmable from below.

headline: A Game Studio Fits Inside One Session
lede: Claude Code Game Studios lays out a complete production system for solo creators and small teams. Specialized agents, scoped rules, validation hooks, templates, and engine-specific workflows provide the drawings, checkpoints, and review gates behind a disciplined build.

headline: FreeToken Brings Giant MoE Models Home
lede: FreeToken treats GPU memory, CPU capacity, and system RAM as one elastic inference pool for models beyond 290 billion parameters. Expert caching, streamed prefill, semantic reuse, and dynamic VRAM allocation make the benchmark local rather than datacenter-bound.

headline: T3 Code Puts Coding Agents on Call
lede: T3 Code is a practical control surface for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other local agents. Its launcher, remote-ready server, mobile clients, and desktop interfaces let developers supervise existing tools without surrendering execution to a hosted editor.

headline: Kronos Forecasts Markets as Tokens
lede: Kronos converts OHLCV market sequences into hierarchical discrete tokens, then forecasts them with decoder-only Transformers. With pretrained models, fine-tuning scripts, visualization tools, and backtesting examples, it gives quantitative researchers a compact starting point for financial time-series experiments.

headline: Kornia Makes Computer Vision Differentiable
lede: Kornia brings more than 1,200 vision and geometry operators directly into PyTorch’s tensor and autograd model. Batched GPU execution, camera transforms, robust estimation, augmentation, compilation, and export make the library a serious foundation for spatial systems.

headline: Colibrì Streams Frontier Models from Disk
lede: Colibrì uses storage, RAM, and VRAM as a tiered memory hierarchy, loading only the MoE experts each route requires. Its C engine keeps massive models on consumer workstations, giving developers a more transparent and locally controlled alternative to hyperscaler inference.
